1.why: Moffenzeef 2.6.1 source (github.com/moffenzeefmodular/VCVrack-submission commit e6a0c67), src/DialUp.cpp:68-72: normalizedCV = (cvInput + 5.0f) / 10.0f then knob1Value = knob1Param + (normalizedCV - 0.5f), clamped 0..1, with the maker comment "Map -5V -> 0.0 and 5V -> 1.0"; mono: the plugin reads every input with getVoltage() and the only setChannels in src is Kleztizer.cpp:305

comment: Read from the maker's source at 2.6.1, commit e6a0c67. The generator multiplies a rising counter by a value between 1 and 256 taken from the rate setting and takes a parity bit of the product, giving a square wave of ±5V. A random step is added to the rate every few hundred samples and the running total is clamped to ±1, so the pitch drifts between triggers. Two one-pole filters sit on the output at 2*pi*100 and 2*pi*10000 radians per second; the corner frequencies those imply are not stated by the maker and are left out of the lines.
